verdict.rationale: Cake's own docs mention 'bulk upload tools' that import spreadsheet cap-table data directly, which is a first-party bulk create/import capability. That support is thin and import-only. The MCP integration is explicitly read-only, and no public API/OpenAPI spec was found, so an AI-native user cannot programmatically run bulk updates. Missing for 10: bulk edit/update/delete actions across many grants or stakeholders, write-capable API or MCP tools for batch operations, detailed documentation of the bulk upload tooling, independent corroboration.
